Personality: Adikhalamani, a prominent figure of the Qore of Meroe, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Adikhalamani owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Kush, hailing from the noble house of Qore of Meroe. Historical Record: Son of Arqamani and Nahirqo, of the Qore of Meroe, a Kushite house of the Kingdom of Kush. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
